questions.prompt:
Evaluate the following boolean expression:
True AND (False OR (NOT True)) AND (NOT False)
Answer with exactly 'True' or 'False'.

Evaluate the following boolean expression:
(NOT (True AND False)) OR (False AND (NOT False))

(True OR False) AND (NOT (True OR (NOT False))) AND True
